buildCommand: echo "PWD=$PWD"; echo "--- here:"; ls -a; echo "--- parent:"; ls -a ..; R=""; for d in . .. ../.. ../../..; do if [ -f "$d/yarn.lock" ]; then R="$d"; break; fi; done; echo "ROOT=$R"; if [ -z "$R" ]; then echo "!! no yarn.lock anywhere above"; exit 1; fi; OUT="$PWD/vercel-static"; rm -rf "$OUT"; cd "$R"; COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 LICHTBLICK_OUT="$OUT" corepack yarn web:build:prod; echo "--- output:"; ls "$OUT/index.html"; find "$OUT" -type f | wc -l
